observations: All 32 complete full-body poses are visible in an eight-column, four-row layout.
Blue-scaled anthropomorphic wyrmborn identity, pale horns, purple wings, slate tail and red/gold costume remain recognizable.
Front, true side profiles, rear quarters and full backs are distinguishable in the requested order.
Rising row has folded knees and tucked feet; descending row has more open legs and feet beneath the pelvis.
Landing row visibly lowers the pelvis and bends the knees more deeply than anticipation, especially in front and profile views.
No gross skull enlargement, missing extremity, cropping, merged neighbor, wrong grid or facing defect observed at source size.
Wings and tails have visible clearance from neighbors and sheet edges; hands are empty with no baked effects, ground shadows or text.
limitations: Rear hands and limbs are partly occluded naturally by wings, torso or tail in some views.
Exact common skull dimensions, limb-length continuity, root registration and row crop bands require lead-owned assembly measurements.
A large number of generated pixels have partial alpha. Any deterministic alpha thresholding and hidden-RGB cleanup belongs to lead assembly; this original remains untouched.
The wing and tail envelopes dominate some silhouettes; leg-pose readability at native game scale has not been verified.
Four authored jump keys are provided, not a complete animation cycle or independently tested transitions.

scope: Only source PNG, exact prompt and receipt written; no runtime, engine, gameplay, shared manifest, builder, import, export, commit or push changes.
